name: weBump Platform API preview
description: Developer preview: reviewed projects, explicit player approval, scoped bearer tokens, game-defined private JSON saves, separately opted-in selected shared JSON, public showcases and eligible visitors. Public client IDs are not secrets: copying configuration can initiate a request but cannot alone access protected player data. Redirect callbacks protect code delivery with PKCE, not the origin of later API requests. Reviewed device grants authorize the device the player confirms; neither method attests an official app binary. CORS is not client authentication. See https://developer.webump.app/tutorial#security-model. Rate-limit budgets and retry guidance: https://developer.webump.app/rate-limits.html.
